name: Repeatable text flow
description: Run a text step twice, then use its results in the next step.
instructions: Do not use tools or access files. Complete each repetition before proceeding. Only respond to the text instructions.

steps.name: Write a short draft
steps.instructions: Write one short sentence about a useful benefit of reusable workflows. Include the token FLOW-READY in the output.

steps.name: Summarize the drafts
steps.instructions: Summarize the two completed drafts in one sentence. Repeat the exact verification token from the drafts to confirm that prior results are available.
